grades.lower_bound_mechanism: lexicographic monovariant: (sum of p-adic valuations, count of entries > 1)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: invariance of gcd of p-adic valuations under (min(a,b), |a-b|)
grades.notes: Termination via lexicographic monovariant and 'at most one >1' are correct. The 'at least one >1' step is a gap: claiming the product cannot drop to 1 'since all numbers are integers' is a non sequitur (needs lcm>1/product-of-outputs argument). Valuation reduction, invariant, and explicit M formula are correct. Remark 2's pairwise-gcd characterization is false but unused.
